acceptance_criteria: A denied or revoked operation leaves the callback count at zero.

cells.contract: LocalObjectOwner issues weak object references bound to the owning generation and execution lease. Replacement, retirement, foreign owners and closed leases prevent access.

acceptance_criteria: Two independent adapter representations run one observe/apply/verify program and refuse stale or foreign requests.
